channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: MACC to review RM1.1 billion investment linked to ex-minister
item.description: Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission will open investigation papers into a RM1.11 billion investment after reviewing documents from complainants.

item.title: Ringgit surge to RM3.89 signals confidence in Malaysia’s economy
item.description: The ringgit's surge to RM3.89 against the US dollar reflects strong confidence in Malaysia's economic fundamentals and the government's policy direction.

item.title: E-hailing driver denies molesting foreign passenger
item.description: A Johor Bahru e-hailing driver and teacher pleaded not guilty to molesting a Vietnamese passenger, with bail set at RM2,000 ahead of a March mention.

item.title: Malaysia’s economy outperforms with 6.3% Q4 GDP growth
item.description: Strong domestic demand drove Malaysia's 2025 growth to 5.2%, beating forecasts and narrowing the fiscal deficit to 3.7%, with low unemployment and inflation.

item.title: Bangladesh nationalists claim big election win, Islamists cry foul
item.description: Bangladesh Nationalist Party claims a decisive election victory, but rival Jamaat-e-Islami alleges irregularities in the results process. DHAKA: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) claimed a thumping win in the first elections held since a deadly 2024 uprising. item.title: Trump to meet troops behind Maduro capture in Venezuela
item.description: President Donald Trump will meet the special forces who captured Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro in a deadly January raid, hailing the operation as a show of US might. WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump will meet on Friday with the special forces soldiers who captured Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro in a deadly raid in Caracas in January. […]

item.title: E-hailing fare explosion — Netizen asks if drivers are going offline to force price hike
item.description: Netizen questions if e-hailing drivers are going offline to trigger surge pricing after fares jump from RM30 to RM106.

item.title: FINAS to expand disability-inclusive creative workshops nationwide
item.description: Deputy minister announces nationwide rollout of vocal and acting workshops for persons with disabilities to uncover new talent.

item.title: Court of Appeal grants Najib permission to attend civil hearings
item.description: Former prime minister Najib Razak can attend two civil appeal hearings in person after the Court of Appeal approved his application.

item.title: Police seize RM4.9 million in drugs at Padang Besar border
item.description: Perlis police confiscated nearly 100kg of methamphetamine and arrested a local man after a high-risk operation near the Malaysia-Thailand border.
